cursor.execute\(''SELECT * FROM corporate_groups WHERE name LIKE ""%카카오%""''\)
for row in cursor.fetchall\(\):
    print\(row\)

# 카카오 계열사
print\(''\\n=== 카카오 계열사 \(처음 10개\) ===''\)
cursor.execute\(''SELECT id, name, corporate_number, business_number FROM affiliates WHERE group_code IN \(SELECT code FROM corporate_groups WHERE name LIKE ""%카카오%""\) LIMIT 10''\)
for row in cursor.fetchall\(\):
    print\(row\)

# 법인등록번호 null 개수

    SELECT 
        COUNT\(*\) as total,
        SUM\(CASE WHEN corporate_number IS NULL OR corporate_number = """" THEN 1 ELSE 0 END\) as null_count
    FROM affiliates 
    WHERE group_code IN \(SELECT code FROM corporate_groups WHERE name LIKE ""%카카오%""\)
''''''\)
row = cursor.fetchone\(\)

from affiliate_api.database import SessionLocal
from affiliate_api.models import HoldingCompanyRelation, Stockholder, Affiliate

db = SessionLocal\(\)

# 1. 울산아로마틱스 법인번호 찾기
print\(''=== 울산아로마틱스 계열사 정보 ===''\)
affiliate = db.query\(Affiliate\).filter\(Affiliate.name.like\(''%울산아로마틱스%''\)\).first\(\)
if affiliate:
    print\(f''회사명: {affiliate.name}''\)
    print\(f''법인번호: {affiliate.corporate_number}''\)
    corp_num = affiliate.corporate_number
else:
    print\(''Not found''\)
    corp_num = None

# 2. 에스케이지오센트릭 법인번호 찾기
print\(\)
print\(''=== 에스케이지오센트릭 계열사 정보 ===''\)
parent = db.query\(Affiliate\).filter\(Affiliate.name.like\(''%에스케이지오센트릭%''\)\).first\(\)
if parent:
    print\(f''회사명: {parent.name}''\)
    print\(f''법인번호: {parent.corporate_number}''\)
    parent_corp = parent.corporate_number
else:
    print\(''Not found''\)
    parent_corp = None

# 3. 지주회사 관계 테이블에서 확인
print\(\)
print\(''=== HoldingCompanyRelation 테이블 ===''\)
if corp_num:
    relations = db.query\(HoldingCompanyRelation\).filter\(
        HoldingCompanyRelation.subsidiary_name.like\(''%울산아로마틱스%''\)
    \).all\(\)
    for r in relations:
        print\(f''지주회사: {r.holding_group_name}''\)
        print\(f''상위회사: {r.parent_corp_number}''\)
        print\(f''자회사: {r.subsidiary_name} \({r.subsidiary_corp_number}\)''\)
        print\(f''지분율: {r.ownership_rate}%''\)
        print\(f''관계유형: {r.relation_type}''\)
        print\(''---''\)

# 4. 주주현황 테이블에서 울산아로마틱스의 주주 확인
print\(\)
print\(''=== 울산아로마틱스 주주현황 ===''\)
if corp_num:
    stockholders = db.query\(Stockholder\).filter\(
        Stockholder.corp_number == corp_num
    \).order_by\(Stockholder.total_rate.desc\(\)\).all\(\)
    print\(f''총 {len\(stockholders\)}건''\)
    for s in stockholders:
        print\(f''  주주: {s.stockholder_name} | 유형: {s.stockholder_type} | 지분율: {s.total_rate}% | 연도: {s.designation_year}''\)

db.close\(\)
")
